# tfutils_aws_eks_nodes_ready_wait (Resource)

On create, waits until at least `min_ready` nodes of an EKS cluster are `Ready`, for example before an `aws_eks_addon` whose pods cannot be scheduled until a node is ready. It uses only the AWS credentials of the provider, not the `kubernetes` block, so it works in the apply that creates the cluster, before an OIDC identity provider or RBAC binding exists: it reads the endpoint and CA with EKS `DescribeCluster` and lists the nodes with an EKS IAM token, as `aws eks get-token` issues. The token is issued again for every request and is not stored in the plan or state. The credentials need `eks:DescribeCluster` on the cluster, and their IAM principal needs permission to list nodes in Kubernetes, for example through an EKS access entry or as the cluster creator. A cluster without an endpoint yet means not yet; a missing, `FAILED` or `DELETING` cluster, and a 401 or 403 from the API server, fail at once. Apply fails with the last count of ready nodes when the create timeout passes. Read makes no request; the wait runs again only when the inputs or `triggers` change. Destroy does nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tfutils_aws_eks_nodes_ready_wait" "system" {
  cluster_name   = aws_eks_cluster.this.name
  label_selector = "eks.amazonaws.com/nodegroup=${aws_eks_node_group.system.node_group_name}"
  min_ready      = 1

  depends_on = [aws_eks_node_group.system]
}

# The addon turns ACTIVE as soon as its pods are scheduled, instead of waiting for the next check of EKS.
resource "aws_eks_addon" "coredns" {
  cluster_name = aws_eks_cluster.this.name
  addon_name   = "coredns"

  depends_on = [tfutils_aws_eks_nodes_ready_wait.system]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the EKS cluster in the region of the provider.

### Optional

- `label_selector` (String) Kubernetes label selector of the nodes to count, for example `eks.amazonaws.com/nodegroup=system`. All nodes are counted when it is not set.
- `min_ready` (Number) Number of nodes whose `Ready` condition must be `True` to finish.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values whose change replaces the resource and runs the wait again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `cluster_name`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
